record.one_liner: Team chat and messaging platform (channels, direct chats, bots and integrations) from Zoho.
record.auth_notes: REST API uses OAuth 2.0 only: client ID/secret registered in the Zoho developer console, grant code, then access and refresh tokens.
record.access_notes: Developer client registration is self-serve. A Free plan exists; the docs did not confirm that API access is included on Free, so confidence is medium.
record.api_notes: Versioned REST API v2 with resource endpoints for networks, channels, messages and more. Breadth was not fully enumerated.
record.blocker_notes: No blocker seen for building a test toolkit. Production third-party distribution review was not checked.
